summary: The candidate correctly removes one repeated Gemma 4 vision GPU-to-host max-seqlen synchronization and its focused contract and GPU numerical behavior are verified. It is a partial fix only: the original Gemma-4-31B-it TP=8 hybrid-SWA readiness hang was not reproducible in the available one-GPU, no-weights environment.

tests.what_was_measured: At the recorded base, both exact candidate regression cases fail with KeyError because Gemma4VisionAttention does not forward max_seqlen.
At exact candidate commit, 9 focused forwarding and precomputed-max-seqlen tests passed.
On gfx950, reproduced large errors 1.60046387 and 2.66284180 without a forward scale; actual Gemma semantics with forward softmax_scale=1.0 matched PyTorch SDPA with max error 0.00195312.
Independent dense boundary and non-square batch/sequence cases matched PyTorch SDPA with maximum absolute errors 0, 0.00195312, and 0.00195312.

gpu_evidence: Direct VisionTritonAttention kernels executed on one AMD Instinct MI355X, arch gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, with PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015.
remaining_counterexamples: No evidence shows /health reaches HTTP 200 for Gemma-4-31B-it with TP=8 and hybrid SWA on AMD/ROCm.
Removing the host .item() synchronization does not establish that earlier GPU kernels or TP collectives cannot remain stalled.
remaining_limitations: Only one gfx950 AMD Instinct MI355X was assigned; TP=8 and the reported eight Radeon AI PRO R9700 topology were unavailable.
Gemma-4-31B-it weights were unavailable, so the full model, multimodal path, hybrid SWA allocation, and HTTP readiness were not exercised.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
